explanation: Puccini died before finishing Turandot. At the premiere, the conductor Arturo Toscanini laid down his baton where Puccini's own music ended and told the audience so.

claims.text: Nessun dorma is an aria from Puccini's opera Turandot.
Nessun dorma does not appear in La Bohème, Tosca or Madama Butterfly.
At Turandot's premiere, Arturo Toscanini stopped the performance at the point where Puccini's own music ended and told the audience so.
